resources.string: Keeps ConfigFS active if Android resets the USB configuration. Use when the disk disconnects or is not detected.
Could not keep the USB disk connected. Eject the images and check diagnostics.

Another USB configuration has taken the controller. Enable compatibility mode and automatic USB switching, then try connecting the image again. While hosting, the phone’s USB file transfer and wired ADB will be unavailable; Wi-Fi ADB can still be used.
Another USB configuration has taken the controller even with compatibility mode enabled. Check USB diagnostics and other apps that manage USB before trying again.
